- Objective: Estimate the risk that a heart-failure patient dies during the follow-up period so clinicians can prioritise care. Each prediction is made at the patient's clinical assessment using measurements and history recorded there; anything recorded later, including how long the patient was followed, is unavailable when the prediction is made.

## Summary
The run aimed to estimate follow-up mortality risk from information available at clinical assessment, excluding follow-up duration. Several classifiers were evaluated, and a scaled RBF-kernel support vector machine was delivered as the verified model.
